name: memos
title: Memos
description: Capture, find and manage your Memos notes without leaving Raycast.
author: youscef

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup Memos
commands.subtitle: Memos
commands.description: Connect Raycast to your Memos instance and check that your access token works

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: Address of your Memos instance, e.g. https://memos.example.com. Leave the default to try the public demo.
preferences.placeholder: Use https://demo.usememos.com, or your server URL

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Create one in Memos under Settings → Access Tokens, e.g. https://demo.usememos.com/setting#access-token

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
